---
name: discovery
description: "Use when someone asks for a discovery pass or for discovery candidates, not for an ordinary request to look into something. Runs prompts/discovery.md — with nothing given, Stage 0: a read-only survey of this repo for the questions worth a discovery pass before the next piece of work, ending at the candidate list; given a candidate, a filled-in Stage 1 drafted for review, not run."
argument-hint: <nothing for the Stage 0 survey, or the candidate to draft a Stage 1 for>
---

<!-- Claude Code's copy of .agents/skills/discovery/SKILL.md, generated by the template's skills:build script; its frontmatter differs by design. Edit the .agents/ file and carry the same change into this one. -->

Run the discovery template exactly as written in `prompts/discovery.md`. Read that file in full
first; it is the authoritative instruction set, and this skill only wires it up. What was given
with the request picks the stage:

1. **Nothing given, or only the upcoming work: run Stage 0 on this repo.** Fill its
   placeholders from the repo: the project's name; the orientation files it actually has (its
   agent instructions, README, docs index, any decisions or open-questions file); the upcoming
   work as given, else the prompt's default, the work this project's own plan says is next; the
   count, the prompt's example unless the request gives one. Ask, in one question, only for
   what the repo can't supply. Then follow the filled prompt. It's a survey: read only, change
   nothing, and stop after the candidate list.
2. **A candidate given: draft its Stage 1, and don't run it.** Fill the Stage 1 template from
   what Stage 0 found for that candidate; if this session has no Stage 0 entry for it, gather
   that entry's evidence first, read-only. Delete the blocks the task doesn't need, leave as
   `{{PLACEHOLDERS}}` the facts only the person can supply, search the draft for leftover `{{`,
   and list each one left. Give the draft as one fenced block, to review and run in a fresh
   session ("Running it" in the template): a discovery pass answers from the files, not from the
   session that chose it.
